title: View-oriented Conversation Compiler for Agent Trace Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2603.29678v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We observe that an agent trace is a structured document. A coding agent session contains user turns, assistant text, chain of thought blocks, tool calls, tool results, subagent invocations, compaction boundaries, and harness injected directives, and may exceed ten thousand JSONL lines. Effective trace analysis requires a lossless record, a session level overview, and content retrieval with conversational roles. To this end, we propose VCC, namely View oriented Conversation Compiler, which lexes, parses, and lowers a raw JSONL log into three views based on one intermediate representation. The full view provides the lossless transcript and defines the line number coordinate system. The UI view reconstructs the interaction perceived by the user. The adaptive view selects relevant trace content and preserves role annotations and line range pointers. Line numbers are assigned before view lowering, ensuring that all pointers can be resolve

translated_title: 面向视图的智能体轨迹分析对话编译器
translated_abstract: 我们观察到智能体轨迹是一种结构化文档。一个编码智能体会话包含用户轮次、助手文本、思维链块、工具调用、工具结果、子智能体调用、压缩边界以及框架注入的指令，并且可能超过一万行JSONL。有效的轨迹分析需要无损记录、会话级概览以及带有对话角色的内容检索。为此，我们提出了VCC，即面向视图的对话编译器，它基于一个中间表示，对原始JSONL日志进行词法分析、语法分析并下降为三个视图。完整视图提供无损的转录文本并定义了行号坐标系。UI视图重建用户所感知的交互。自适应视图选择相关的轨迹内容并保留角色注释和行范围指针。行号在视图下降之前被分配，从而确保所有指针都可以被解析。
tldr: 提出了面向视图的对话编译器VCC，基于单一中间表示将智能体轨迹JSONL日志编译为完整视图、UI视图和自适应视图三个视图，同时实现无损记录、会话级概览和带对话角色的内容检索。
en_tdlr: VCC, a view-oriented conversation compiler, lowers raw agent-trace JSONL logs into three views (full, UI, and adaptive) based on a single intermediate representation, enabling lossless recording, session-level overview, and role-aware content retrieval.
